notes: Breadboard column/row positions were read from the image. The upper section of the drawn breadboard is rows f-j, so it maps to bank 'b' in the catalogue.
LED anode is the longer, bent leg in column 6. The cathode is in column 8.
The resistor spans columns 4 and 6 in row h. The orange wire from pin 9 enters column 4 in row g.
The black wire goes from the GND header pin beside AREF (GND.1) to column 8, row h, which is the LED cathode strip.
The manual says 220 ohm. The resistor is a standard catalogue part with a value prop.
